key_highlights: ASX slumps as miners and banks sell off sharply; oil near US$100 on Iran conflict spillover
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD faces further downside risk amid global inflation fears and oil shock
Austal (AST.AX) jumps on US$1.9b acquisition bid
WA gold exploration surge: Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania all advancing projects
Australian business conditions weakest since pandemic; diesel at 2022 record
High-end property prices falling while affordable segment holds; NSW stamp duty hit looms
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
Chinese inflation surge threatens commodity demand outlook

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off in iron ore names; iron ore trouble spreading. However, WA gold exploration remains active with multiple drill-out announcements. Copper (Flagship) and silver (Patriot) exploration expanding.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from iron ore weakness and Chinese inflation. Gold juniors (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon) benefit from safe-haven flows. Diversified miners face margin compression.

sectors.trend: Banks sharply lower in ASX slump. Private credit stress (Bathla) raises credit-risk concerns. Housing market bifurcation (high-end falling, affordable resilient) complicates NIM outlook.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate uncertainty and property risk. Private credit exposure a new watch item. NSW stamp duty hit may reduce transaction volumes.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict; diesel at 2022 record. Inpex (INX.AX) rectifying emissions errors. Gas reservation sold by Albo government. Data centres straining energy transition.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. Inpex faces governance overhang. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (headline 43) creates long-term structural demand but delays decarbonisation.

sectors.trend: Dementia prevention research highlights systemic gaps. Consumer pressure from diesel/inflation. Kroger (KR) sales slowing on inflation. CSL.AX relatively insulated.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX defensive. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) face margin squeeze from input costs. Healthcare policy focus on prevention may shift funding.

sectors.trend: Austal (AST.AX) US$1.9b bid positive. AI data centre build-out at coal sites. Intel $20b raise stabilising. Crypto/prediction market activity (Robinhood, Bitmine).
sectors.implications: AST.AX bid provides M&A catalyst. Data centre demand supports industrial/infrastructure names. AI capex cycle continues but energy constraints may slow rollout.

sectors.trend: High-end property seeing steepest falls; affordable end resilient. NSW stamp duty hit threatens transaction volumes. Property chiefs calling for more migrants to address supply.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals. Residential construction (WBC.AX, GPT.AX) supported by affordable demand but constrained by supply. Stamp duty changes may reduce NSW volumes.

key_themes: Oil at US$100 driven by Iran conflict – inflationary shock to global and Australian markets
Iron ore demand weakness amid Chinese inflation surge
AUD depreciation risk ('shocker') from oil import bill and global risk-off
WA gold exploration super-cycle continues with multiple drill-out announcements
Private credit stress (Bathla) as emerging systemic risk
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
Energy transition vs AI data centre demand tension
Business conditions at pandemic lows – consumer and corporate confidence deteriorating

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); reduce oil-importing consumer exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand deterioration / Chinese inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper names
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners and gold; monitor RBA response
Review bank private credit exposure; favour large-cap banks with transparent lending books
Avoid luxury REITs; favour affordable-housing and construction plays; monitor NSW stamp duty policy
Favour defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); reduce cyclical consumer exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict; diesel at 2022 record supports upstream margins

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into WA gold exploration names
opportunities.rationale: Multiple drill-out announcements (Gateway $45M, Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon high-grade hits); safe-haven demand on risk-off
US$1.9b bid provides near-term re-rating; defence/shipbuilding tailwind
Flagship expanding copper in Canada; Patriot securing Peruvian silver; structural demand from data centres and EVs

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreading; Chinese inflation signals demand softness; ASX miners leading lower

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce consumer cyclicals
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker risk; business conditions at pandemic lows; diesel inflation squeezing margins
Steepest price falls at top end; NSW stamp duty hit; housing correction risk concentrated in premium segment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor private credit exposure in bank holdings
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse rippling through private credit; potential contagion to listed lenders

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil near US$100 and iron ore weakness create headwinds for materials and banks. AUD depreciation risk adds import-inflation pressure. RBA caught between growth slowdown and oil-driven inflation. Expect elevated volatility. Gold and energy names outperform; iron ore and consumer cyclicals lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and Chinese demand recovers. WA gold exploration cycle and copper/silver structural demand support mining rotation. Data centre build-out creates sustained energy and infrastructure demand. Housing bifurcation may moderate as policy responds. Key risk: prolonged Iran conflict or Chinese deflationary spiral.

WA gold drill-out results (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon)

RBA cash rate and inflation forecast
NSW housing transaction volumes and stamp duty policy
